items.title: Stanley Kay interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: Maurice and I have been together 30 years.

ctx.x: You and John Levy are, I think, probably the great managers to have, because you went through it. You were musicians.

Well and I always will be a musician. I will always be — I mean I managed the Hines Brothers for a long time, I did a show on Broadway. Maurice and I have been together 30 years. But if I could produce the biggest show on Broadway I’m a sideman. I will always be a musician. I would rather talk to guys and hear the story than talk to David Merrick. He doesn’t interest me. I like to talk to the guys. And sometimes they can’t drag me away because I’m laughing, talking the stories. That’s where I come from, that’s…
